query:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T09:20:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:25:00.000Z"
        AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.11" OR client.ip == "172.18.0.11" OR host.ip == "172.18.0.11")
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name, data_stream.dataset
| SORT events DESC
